updates.title: SEC proposes rescission of the Climate-Related Disclosure Rules
updates.description: The SEC has proposed to rescind its 2024 final rules requiring registrants to provide climate-related disclosures in registration statements and annual reports. If adopted, the rescission would eliminate requirements for Scope 1, Scope 2, and material Scope 3 GHG emissions disclosures, climate risk governance and strategy disclosures, and financial statement footnotes related to climate impacts.

updates.title: PCAOB proposes amendments to QC 1000 ahead of December 2026 effective date
updates.description: Registered public accounting firms must implement a comprehensive risk-based quality control system (QC 1000) and comply with amended audit planning, supervision, documentation and engagement deficiency response requirements for audits with reporting periods on or after 15 December 2026.

updates.title: GRI 101: Biodiversity and GRI 14: Mining Sector Standard take effect for reporting from 1 January 2026
updates.description: GRI 101: Biodiversity 2024 and GRI 14: Mining Sector 2024 become effective for reports covering periods starting on or after 1 January 2026. Organizations in the mining sector must now disclose impacts on biodiversity, land use, water stewardship, and community rights using the new topic-specific and sector-specific standards.

updates.title: GRI opens consultations on revised economic-impact standards (corruption, competition, public policy) and 2026-2028 GSSB work programme
updates.description: The Global Sustainability Standards Board has opened public consultations on exposure drafts revising GRI 205 (Anti-corruption), GRI 206 (Anti-competitive Behavior), and GRI 415 (Public Policy), as well as its proposed 2026-2028 work programme covering new standards on circular economy, human rights due diligence, and digital responsibility.

updates.title: Apply revised ESRS with reduced mandatory datapoints (-61%), new flexibility mechanisms (top-down DMA, phase-ins), and alternative statement layout permitted with justification
updates.description: Apply revised ESRS with reduced mandatory datapoints (-61%), new flexibility mechanisms (top-down DMA, phase-ins), and alternative statement layout permitted with justification. First-time adopters (Wave 1) may defer 'expected financial impacts' reporting until 2028 (qualitative) and 2030 (quantitative).

updates.title: Align industry-specific SASB metrics with IFRS S2 requirements; entities applying IFRS S1 must refer to and consider applicability of amended SASB metrics
updates.description: Align industry-specific SASB metrics with IFRS S2 requirements; entities applying IFRS S1 must refer to and consider applicability of amended SASB metrics as a primary source of guidance for identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

updates.title: Apply amended GHG emissions disclosure requirements in IFRS S2 and aligned financed emissions metrics in three SASB Standards
updates.description: Apply amended GHG emissions disclosure requirements in IFRS S2 and aligned financed emissions metrics in three SASB Standards for reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027.

updates.title: IFRS S1 mandatory adoption in 20+ jurisdictions from 2025
updates.description: IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information became mandatory in over 20 jurisdictions for reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2025. Entities must disclose governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics/targets for sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

updates.title: IFRS S2 Scope 3 GHG disclosure relief extended to reporting periods beginning 2027
updates.description: The ISSB extended the transition relief for Scope 3 GHG emissions disclosure under IFRS S2 to reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027. Entities adopting IFRS S2 before that date may omit Scope 3 disclosures but must disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions from the first reporting period.

updates.title: PCAOB QC 1000 effective for reporting periods on or after 15 December 2026
updates.description: QC 1000: A Firm's System of Quality Control becomes effective for registered public accounting firms for audits with reporting periods on or after 15 December 2026. Firms must implement a comprehensive risk-based quality control system covering governance, ethics, acceptance and continuance, engagement performance, resources, information and communication, and monitoring.

updates.title: European Commission adopts ESRS Set 1 delegated act with sector-agnostic standards
updates.description: The European Commission adopted the first set of European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) covering 12 sector-agnostic standards. Large public-interest entities with more than 500 employees began reporting under CSRD for financial years starting on or after 1 January 2024.

updates.title: FSB TCFD disbanded; ISSB assumes climate-disclosure monitoring from 2024
updates.description: The Financial Stability Board's Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures was formally disbanded in October 2023 after the ISSB published IFRS S1 and S2. The ISSB now monitors adoption of climate-related financial disclosures globally, building on the TCFD framework.

updates.title: SEBI mandates BRSR Core for top 150 listed entities with reasonable assurance
updates.description: SEBI has mandated BRSR Core framework reporting with reasonable assurance for the top 150 listed entities by market capitalisation from FY 2024-25. The top 1000 listed entities must provide limited assurance on BRSR Core disclosures.

updates.title: EU AI Act enters force with GDPR-aligned data governance provisions
updates.description: The EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) entered into force on 1 August 2024, introducing GDPR-aligned provisions for high-risk AI systems processing personal data, including mandatory data governance, transparency, and human oversight requirements.

updates.title: ISSB completes alignment of SASB Standards with IFRS S1 and S2
updates.description: The International Sustainability Standards Board completed the alignment of industry-specific SASB Standards with IFRS S1 (General Requirements) and S2 (Climate-related Disclosures). Entities applying IFRS S1 must now refer to aligned SASB metrics as a primary source of guidance for identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
